Tooltip_craft_YoghurtIncubatorDesc: A Yoghurt Pot wrapped in cloth. Pour in milk steaming from a Hearth's copper and add a yoghurt or a starter; it sets by itself once the milk has cooled to 45 C. Build it, or put it down, within 2 tiles of a Hearth.
Tooltip_craft_StarterCultureCrockDesc: A clay jar or pot under a cloth, for growing a yoghurt starter from wheat and milk when no yoghurt is left to start from. Build it, or put it down, within 2 tiles of a Hearth.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Yog: A wide lidded pot that holds 5 litres. Wrap it in cloth to build a Yoghurt Incubator.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Jar: A litre of home-set yoghurt: four cups. Right-click to spoon it into Empty Yoghurt Containers, one at a time or all at once; the jar comes back with the last cup.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Act: A live culture grown on wheat. Add it to a Yoghurt Incubator to set one batch.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Emp: Wash it and fill it again with home-set yoghurt.
Tooltip_craft_DairyHearthDesc: A low stone oven with a copper set into its top. Light it like a stove; the copper holds 10 L of one fluid and brings milk to the steam for the Yoghurt Incubator and the Starter Culture Crock. The firebox cooks like an oven, and it warms an incubator or crock within 2 tiles.
